parsed.name: 串口真空规
parsed.description: 用于真空系统压力测量的真空规，可通过串行接口接入控制系统。根据配置可对应皮拉尼规或冷阴极规等规管，常用于实验腔体、真空管线和抽气系统的压力监测。
parsed.description_en: A vacuum gauge used to measure pressure in vacuum systems and connected through a serial interface. Depending on the configuration, it may correspond to a Pirani gauge or a cold cathode gauge, and is commonly used for pressure monitoring in experimental chambers, vacuum lines, and pumping systems.
